# Auxiliary functions

**Differences in fit**

`fit_diff()`, to summarize the differences between invariance levels

```{r}
fit_diff <- function(fit1, fit2) {
  lrt <- lavTestLRT(fit1, fit2)
  data.frame(D.chisq = round(lrt$`Chisq diff`[2], 2),
             D.df = lrt$`Df diff`[2],
             pvalue = signif(lrt$`Pr(>Chisq)`[2], 3),
             D.cfi = round(unname(fitMeasures(fit2, "cfi.scaled") -
                                   fitMeasures(fit1, "cfi.scaled")), 3),
             D.rmsea = round(unname(fitMeasures(fit2, "rmsea.scaled") -
                                     fitMeasures(fit1, "rmsea.scaled")), 3))}
```

**Significance of MI violation**

`extract_elements()`, to extract the necessary information for `ThresholdProbability()`

```{r}
extract_elements = function(fit,
                            group.id,
                            factor.names,
                            item.prefixes,
                            n.item,
                            n.threshold) {
  
  par.estim = parameterEstimates(fit)
  
  # --- Item order from loadings (source of truth) ---
  item.names = par.estim[par.estim$op == "=~" &
                         par.estim$group == group.id, "rhs"]
  
  # --- Thresholds (NA-padded, ordered to match loadings) ---
  thres.df  = par.estim[par.estim$op == "|" &
                        Reduce(`|`, lapply(item.prefixes, function(p) startsWith(par.estim$lhs, p))) &
                        par.estim$group == group.id, c("lhs", "est")]
  
  thres.mat = matrix(NA, nrow = length(item.names), ncol = n.threshold)
  
  for (i in seq_along(item.names)) {
    vals = thres.df$est[thres.df$lhs == item.names[i]]
    if (length(vals) > 0) thres.mat[i, 1:length(vals)] = vals }
  
  # --- Loadings ---
  loadings = par.estim[par.estim$op == "=~" &
                       par.estim$group == group.id, "est"]
  
  # --- Factor means ---
  com.factor.mean = par.estim[par.estim$op == "~1" &
                              par.estim$lhs %in% factor.names &
                              par.estim$group == group.id, "est"]
  
  # --- Factor variances ---
  com.factor.var = par.estim[par.estim$op == "~~" &
                             par.estim$lhs %in% factor.names &
                             par.estim$rhs == par.estim$lhs &
                             par.estim$group == group.id, "est"]
  
  # --- Unique factor variances (ordered to match loadings) ---
  uni.factor.var = par.estim[par.estim$op == "~~" &
                             par.estim$rhs == par.estim$lhs &
                             par.estim$lhs %in% item.names &
                             par.estim$group == group.id, "est"]
  
  # --- Item intercepts (ordered to match loadings) ---
  item.int = sapply(item.names, function(v)
    par.estim$est[par.estim$op == "~1" &
                  par.estim$lhs == v &
                  par.estim$group == group.id])
  
  list(loadings        = loadings,
       com.factor.mean = com.factor.mean,
       com.factor.var  = com.factor.var,
       uni.factor.var  = uni.factor.var,
       item.int        = item.int,
       thres.matrix    = thres.mat) }
```

Modified `ThresholdProbability()`, to calculate the estimated probabilities for choosing each response category for each item (Liu et al., 2017)

```{r}
ThresholdProbability = function(n.Item,
                                Loadings,                 # matrix: n.Item x n.Factors
                                Common.Factor.Mean,       # vector: length n.Factors
                                Common.Factor.Variance,   # matrix: n.Factors x n.Factors
                                Unique.Factor.Variances,  # vector: length n.Item
                                n.Threshold,
                                Thresholds,               # matrix: n.Item x n.Threshold
                                Item.Intercepts) {        # vector, length n.Item
  
  LAMBDA = as.matrix(Loadings)                   # n.Item x n.Factors
  KAPPA  = as.matrix(Common.Factor.Mean)         # n.Factors x 1
  PHI    = as.matrix(Common.Factor.Variance)     # n.Factors x n.Factors
  THETA  = diag(Unique.Factor.Variances)         # n.Item x n.Item
  
  MU    = as.matrix(Item.Intercepts) + LAMBDA %*% KAPPA   # CHANGED (was LAMBDA %*% KAPPA): n.Item x 1
  SIGMA = LAMBDA %*% PHI %*% t(LAMBDA) + THETA   # n.Item x n.Item
  
  Item.SDs = sqrt(diag(SIGMA))
  
  p.LE.Threshold      = matrix(NA, nrow = n.Item, ncol = n.Threshold)
  p.within.Thresholds = matrix(NA, nrow = n.Item, ncol = n.Threshold + 1)
  
  for (i in 1:n.Item) {
    for (j in 1:n.Threshold) {
      p.LE.Threshold[i, j] = pnorm(Thresholds[i, j], mean = MU[i], sd = Item.SDs[i]) }}
  
  for (i in 1:n.Item) {
    p.within.Thresholds[i, 1] = p.LE.Threshold[i, 1]
    last.valid = max(which(!is.na(p.LE.Threshold[i, ])))  # handles variable # of thresholds per item
    
    if (last.valid < n.Threshold) {
      # Item has fewer active thresholds than the max
      p.within.Thresholds[i, last.valid + 1] = 1 - p.LE.Threshold[i, last.valid]
      if (last.valid > 1) {
        for (j in 2:last.valid) {
          p.within.Thresholds[i, j] = p.LE.Threshold[i, j] - p.LE.Threshold[i, j - 1] }}}
    else {
      p.within.Thresholds[i, n.Threshold + 1] = 1 - p.LE.Threshold[i, n.Threshold]
      for (j in 2:n.Threshold) {
        p.within.Thresholds[i, j] = p.LE.Threshold[i, j] - p.LE.Threshold[i, j - 1] }}}
  
  return(p.within.Thresholds)}
```

`groupProbability`, to call both previous functions more easily

```{r}
groupProbability = function(fit,
                            n.groups,
                            factor.names,
                            item.prefixes,
                            n.item,
                            n.threshold,
                            group.names = lavInspect(fit, "group.label")) {
  lapply(1:n.groups, function(group_id) {
    t = extract_elements(fit           = fit,
                          group.id      = group_id,
                          factor.names  = factor.names,
                          item.prefixes = item.prefixes,
                          n.item        = n.item,
                          n.threshold   = n.threshold)
    
    ThresholdProbability(n.Item                  = n.item,
                         Loadings                = matrix(t$loadings, nrow = n.item, ncol = length(factor.names)),
                         Common.Factor.Mean      = matrix(t$com.factor.mean, ncol = 1),
                         Common.Factor.Variance  = diag(t$com.factor.var, nrow = length(factor.names)),
                         Unique.Factor.Variances = t$uni.factor.var,
                         n.Threshold             = n.threshold,
                         Thresholds              = t$thres.matrix,
                         Item.Intercepts         = t$item.int) }) %>%
    setNames(group.names)}
```

# I. Data preparation

## 1. Import the data

```{r}
d0 = read_sav("TBIMS_cleaned.sav") %>%
  mutate(across(1:26 & where(haven::is.labelled), haven::as_factor),
         across(-(1:26), \(x) { attributes(x) = NULL; x }) ) %>%
  haven::zap_formats()
```

**Prepare the data**

Keep only timepoints 1-4 and remove "PRTVol"

```{r}
parto0 = d0 %>%
  select(UID, Age, Race, Sex, Mar, EduYears,
         Cause, CTComp, GCSTot,
         matches("PRT.*\\.[1-4]$", ignore.case=FALSE),
         -matches("PRTVol"))
```

Recode items into ordered factors

```{r}
parto0 = parto0 %>%
  mutate(across(matches("^PRT(Home|School|Work)\\."),
                ~ ordered(.x - 1, levels = 0:5,
                          labels = c("None", "1 - 4 Hours", "5 - 9 Hours",
                                     "10 - 19 Hours", "20 - 34 Hours",
                                     "35 or More Hours"))),
         across(matches("^PRT(SocFrnd|SocFam|EmotSup|Internet|EatOut|Shop|PlaySport)\\."),
                ~ ordered(.x - 1, levels = 0:5,
                          labels = c("None", "1 - 4 Times", "5 - 9 Times",
                                     "10 - 19 Times", "20 - 34 Times",
                                     "35 or More Times"))),
         across(matches("^PRTOutHse\\."),
                ~ ordered(.x - 1, levels = 0:4,
                          labels = c("None", "1 - 2 Days", "3 - 4 Days",
                                     "5 - 6 Days", "7 Days"))),
         across(matches("^PRT(Movie|WtchSport|Religion)\\."),
                ~ ordered(.x - 1, levels = 0:5,
                          labels = c("None", "One Time", "Two Times",
                                     "Three Times", "Four Times",
                                     "Five or More Times"))),
         across(matches("^PRT(Spouse|Relation|Friend)\\."),
                ~ ordered(.x - 1, levels = 0:1, labels = c("No", "Yes"))) )
```

## 2. Datasets

### 16-items

**Check missing data**

```{r}
parto0 <- parto0 %>%
  mutate(
    missing_T1 = rowSums(across(contains("PRT") & ends_with(".1"), is.na)),
    missing_T2 = rowSums(across(contains("PRT") & ends_with(".2"), is.na)),
    missing_T3 = rowSums(across(contains("PRT") & ends_with(".3"), is.na)),
    missing_T4 = rowSums(across(contains("PRT") & ends_with(".4"), is.na)) )
```

Cross-sectional: complete data for each timepoint (divided by race)

```{r}
parto0 %>%
  group_by(Race) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    timepoint_1 = sum(missing_T1 == 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    timepoint_2 = sum(missing_T2 == 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    timepoint_3 = sum(missing_T3 == 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    timepoint_4 = sum(missing_T4 == 0, na.rm = TRUE) ) %>%
  arrange(desc(n))
```

- Available cross-sectional data:
  - White, Black and Hispanic patients
  - Timepoints 1, 2, 3 and 4
  - Lowest n = 226

Longitudinal: complete data for each race (divided by T1, T1+2...)

```{r}
parto0 %>%
  group_by(Race) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    timepoint_1 = sum(missing_T1 == 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    timepoint_1_2 = sum(missing_T1 == 0 & missing_T2 == 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    timepoint_1_2_3 = sum(missing_T1 == 0 & missing_T2 == 0 & missing_T3 == 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    timepoint_1_2_3_4 = sum(missing_T1 == 0 & missing_T2 == 0 & missing_T3 == 0 & missing_T4 == 0, na.rm = TRUE) ) %>%
  arrange(desc(n))
```

- Available longitudinal data:
  - White, Black and Hispanic patients
  - Timepoints 1, 2 and 3
  - Lowest n = 257

**Final dataset**

```{r}
OGparto = parto0 %>%
  filter(Race %in% c("White", "Black", "Hispanic Orgin")) %>%
  select(1:9, matches("\\.[123]$") & !matches("Spouse")) %>%
  mutate(Race = droplevels(Race))
```

### 11-items

**Malec's modifications**

- Productivity item: summed the 3 productivity items (items 1-3: Home, School, Work)
- Social interaction item: summed the 4 social interaction items (items 4-7: SocFrnd, SocFam, EmotSup, Internet)
- Remove overlapping item: remove Spouse (item 15), since its responses are included in Relation (item 16)

```{r}
# New summed items
MLparto <- OGparto %>%
  # Turn relevant items into numeric
  mutate(across(10:30, \(x) as.numeric(x) - 1)) %>%
  # Sum the items
  mutate(
    PRTProductivity.1 = rowSums(pick(PRTHome.1, PRTSchool.1, PRTWork.1)),
    PRTProductivity.2 = rowSums(pick(PRTHome.2, PRTSchool.2, PRTWork.2)),
    PRTProductivity.3 = rowSums(pick(PRTHome.3, PRTSchool.3, PRTWork.3)),
    PRTSocial.1 = rowSums(pick(PRTSocFrnd.1, PRTSocFam.1,
                               PRTEmotSup.1, PRTInternet.1)),
    PRTSocial.2 = rowSums(pick(PRTSocFrnd.2, PRTSocFam.2,
                               PRTEmotSup.2, PRTInternet.2)),
    PRTSocial.3 = rowSums(pick(PRTSocFrnd.3, PRTSocFam.3,
                               PRTEmotSup.3, PRTInternet.3)))

# Re-scale the items
MLparto <- MLparto %>%
  mutate(
    across(starts_with("PRTProductivity."), ~ case_when(
      .x == 0 ~ 0,
      .x == 1 ~ 1,
      .x %in% 2:3 ~ 2,
      .x %in% 4:6 ~ 3,
      .x >= 7 ~ 4, TRUE ~ NA)),
    across(starts_with("PRTSocial."), ~ case_when(
      .x == 0 ~ 0,
      .x %in% 1:4 ~ 1,
      .x %in% 5:9 ~ 2,
      .x %in% 10:14 ~ 3,
      .x >= 15 ~ 4, TRUE ~ NA)) )

# Items as factors
MLparto <- MLparto %>%
  mutate(
    across(starts_with("PRTProductivity."),
           ~ factor(.x, levels = 0:4, ordered = TRUE)),
    across(starts_with("PRTSocial."),
           ~ factor(.x, levels = 0:4, ordered = TRUE)) )

# Re-order items and remove Spouse
MLparto <- MLparto %>%
  select(1:9,
         matches("^PRT(Productivity|Social)\\.(1|2|3)$"),
         matches("^PRT(OutHse|EatOut|Shop|PlaySport|Movie)\\.(1|2|3)$"),
         matches("^PRT(WtchSport|Religion|Relation|Friend)\\.(1|2|3)$"))
```

## 3. Final prep

Create a vectors with fit indices names

```{r}
names_fit = c("chisq.scaled", "df.scaled", "cfi.scaled",
              "rmsea.scaled", "rmsea.ci.lower.scaled",
              "rmsea.ci.upper.scaled", "srmr")

names_short = c("chisq", "df", "chisq/df", "cfi", "rmsea",
                "ci.lower", "ci.upper", "srmr")
```

Remove unnecessary objects

```{r}
rm(d0, parto0)
```

# III. Cross-sectional MI

# III.A. Original version

## 1. One year after TBI

Create the sub-dataset

```{r}
T1.og_parto <- OGparto %>%
  filter(Race %in% c("White", "Black", "Hispanic Orgin"),
         if_all(matches("PRT.*\\.1$"), ~ !is.na(.)) ) %>%
  select(1:9,
         matches("PRT.*\\.1$"))
nrow(T1.og_parto)
```

Create the model

```{r}
T1.og_mod = 'Participation =~ PRTHome.1 + PRTSchool.1 + PRTWork.1
                            + PRTSocFrnd.1 + PRTSocFam.1
                            + PRTEmotSup.1 + PRTInternet.1
                            + PRTOutHse.1 + PRTEatOut.1 + PRTShop.1
                            + PRTPlaySport.1 + PRTMovie.1 + PRTWtchSport.1
                            + PRTReligion.1 + PRTRelation.1 + PRTFriend.1'
```

**Descriptive statistics**

```{r}
table1( ~ Sex +
          Age +
          Race +
          Mar +
          EduYears +
          Cause +
          GCSTot +
          CTComp,
        data = T1.og_parto)
```


### 1.1. Configural

Create the model

```{r, message=FALSE}
T1.og_mod1 = as.character(measEq.syntax(T1.og_mod,
                                data = T1.og_parto,         
                                ordered = T,           
                                parameterization = "delta",   
                                ID.fac = "std.lv",            
                                ID.cat = "Wu.Estabrook.2016", 
                                group = "Race",
                                group.equal = "configural")) 
```

Fit the model

```{r, message=FALSE}
T1.og_fit1 = cfa(T1.og_mod1,
              data = T1.og_parto,
              ordered = T,
              group = "Race")
```

Check fit measures

```{r}
fitMeasures(T1.og_fit1, fit.measures = names_fit)
```

### 1.2. Thresholds

Create the model

```{r, message=FALSE}
T1.og_mod2 = as.character(measEq.syntax(T1.og_mod,
                                data = T1.og_parto,         
                                ordered = T,           
                                parameterization = "delta",   
                                ID.fac = "std.lv",            
                                ID.cat = "Wu.Estabrook.2016", 
                                group = "Race",
                                group.equal = "thresholds")) 
```

Fit the model

```{r, message=FALSE}
T1.og_fit2 = cfa(T1.og_mod2,
              data = T1.og_parto,
              ordered = T,
              group = "Race")
```

Check fit measures

```{r}
fitMeasures(T1.og_fit2, fit.measures = names_fit)
```

**Comparison**

```{r}
fit_diff(T1.og_fit1, T1.og_fit2)
```

#### Significance

Given the rejection of the level, differences in predicted probabilities are used to discover if the violation has a significant effect size (Liu et al., 2017).

*Retained: configural model*

```{r}
prob_T1og_fit1 = groupProbability(fit = T1.og_fit1,
                                n.groups = 3,
                                factor.names = c("Participation"),
                                item.prefixes = c("PRT"),
                                n.item = 16,
                                n.threshold = 5)
```

*Rejected: threshold model*

```{r}
prob_T1og_fit2 = groupProbability(fit = T1.og_fit2,
                                n.groups = 3,
                                factor.names = c("Participation"),
                                item.prefixes = c("PRT"),
                                n.item = 16,
                                n.threshold = 5)
```

### 1.3. Loadings

Create the model

```{r, message=FALSE}
T1.og_mod3 = as.character(measEq.syntax(T1.og_mod,
                                data = T1.og_parto,         
                                ordered = T,           
                                parameterization = "delta",   
                                ID.fac = "std.lv",            
                                ID.cat = "Wu.Estabrook.2016", 
                                group = "Race",
                                group.equal = c("thresholds", "loadings"))) 
```

Fit the model

```{r, message=FALSE}
T1.og_fit3 = cfa(T1.og_mod3,
              data = T1.og_parto,
              ordered = T,
              group = "Race")
```

Check fit measures

```{r}
fitMeasures(T1.og_fit3, fit.measures = names_fit)
```

**Comparison**

```{r}
fit_diff(T1.og_fit2, T1.og_fit3)
```

### Full comparison

Fit indices

```{r}
T1.og_MI <- rbind(
  configural = fitmeasures(T1.og_fit1, fit.measures = names_fit),
  threshold  = fitmeasures(T1.og_fit2, fit.measures = names_fit),
  loading    = fitmeasures(T1.og_fit3, fit.measures = names_fit))

T1.og_MI <- T1.og_MI %>%
  cbind(., chisq_df = .[, "chisq.scaled"] / .[, "df.scaled"]) %>%
  .[, c("chisq.scaled", "df.scaled", "chisq_df", "cfi.scaled", "rmsea.scaled",
        "rmsea.ci.lower.scaled", "rmsea.ci.upper.scaled", "srmr")]

T1.og_MI = round(T1.og_MI, 3)
colnames(T1.og_MI) = names_short
```

Differences in fit indices

```{r}
T1.og_diff <- rbind(
  conf_thres = fit_diff(T1.og_fit1, T1.og_fit2),
  thres_load = fit_diff(T1.og_fit2, T1.og_fit3))
```

**All results**

```{r}
T1.og_results = list(MI = T1.og_MI,
                     diff = T1.og_diff)
T1.og_results
```

### Remove objects

```{r, eval=TRUE}
rm(T1.og_parto, T1.og_mod)
rm(T1.og_mod1, T1.og_mod2, T1.og_mod3)
rm(T1.og_fit1, T1.og_fit2, T1.og_fit3)
rm(prob_T1og_fit1, prob_T1og_fit2)
rm(T1.og_MI, T1.og_diff)
```

## 3. Five years after TBI

Create the sub-dataset

```{r}
T3.og_parto <- OGparto %>%
  filter(Race %in% c("White", "Black", "Hispanic Orgin"),
         if_all(matches("PRT.*\\.3$"), ~ !is.na(.)) ) %>%
  select(1:9,
         matches("PRT.*\\.3$"))
nrow(T3.og_parto)
```

Create the model

```{r}
T3.og_mod = 'Participation =~ PRTHome.3 + PRTSchool.3 + PRTWork.3
                            + PRTSocFrnd.3 + PRTSocFam.3
                            + PRTEmotSup.3 + PRTInternet.3
                            + PRTOutHse.3 + PRTEatOut.3 + PRTShop.3
                            + PRTPlaySport.3 + PRTMovie.3 + PRTWtchSport.3
                            + PRTReligion.3 + PRTRelation.3 + PRTFriend.3'
```

**Descriptive statistics**

```{r}
table1( ~ Sex +
          Age +
          Race +
          Mar +
          EduYears +
          Cause +
          GCSTot +
          CTComp,
        data = T3.og_parto)
```

**Fixing problematic item**

After first attempting the configural model, item "Work" is flagged as not having "the same number of thresholds on every occasion"

```{r}
table(T3.og_parto$PRTShop.3, T3.og_parto$Race)
```

-   Given that some response categories are empty, they are collapsed to make the number of thresholds equal:
    -   "20-34 times" and "35 or more times" are collapsed into "20 or more times"

```{r}
T3.og_parto <- T3.og_parto %>%
  mutate(across(matches("PRTShop.3"),
      ~ case_when(
        grepl("None", ., ignore.case = F) ~ "None",
        grepl("1 - 4 Times", ., ignore.case = F) ~ "1 - 4 Times",
        grepl("5 - 9 Times", ., ignore.case = F) ~ "5 - 9 Times",
        grepl("10 - 19 Times", ., ignore.case = F) ~ "10 - 19 Times",
        grepl("20 - 34 Times|35 or More Times", .,
              ignore.case = F) ~ "20 or More Times",
    TRUE ~ NA) )) %>%
  mutate(across(matches("PRTShop.3"),
      ~ factor(.x,
               levels = c("None", "1 - 4 Times", "5 - 9 Times",
                          "10 - 19 Times", "20 or More Times"),
               ordered = TRUE)))
```

Create the model

```{r, message=FALSE}
                                ID.cat = "Wu.Estabrook.2016", 
                                group = "Race",
                                group.equal = "configural")) 
```

# III.B. Malec's version

## Descriptive: proportions per timepoint

```{r}
proportions <- MLparto %>%
  select(matches("^PRT")) %>%
  split.default(sapply(., \(x) paste(levels(x), collapse = "|"))) %>%
  map(\(d) d %>%
        pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = c("item", "timepoint"),
                     names_sep = "\\.", values_to = "response") %>%
        drop_na(response) %>%
        count(item, timepoint, response, .drop = FALSE) %>%
        mutate(prop = round(n / sum(n), 2), .by = c(item, timepoint)) %>%
        pivot_wider(id_cols = item, names_from = c(response, timepoint),
                    values_from = prop, names_sort = TRUE))
```

```{r, message=FALSE}
              data = T3.ml_parto,
              ordered = T,
              group = "Race")
```

Check fit measures

```{r}
fitMeasures(T3.ml_fit2, fit.measures = names_fit)
```

**Comparison**

```{r}
fit_diff(T3.ml_fit1, T3.ml_fit2)
```

#### Significance

Given the rejection of the level, differences in predicted probabilities are used to discover if the violation has a significant effect size (Liu et al., 2017).

*Retained: configural model*

```{r}
prob_T3ml_fit1 = groupProbability(fit = T3.ml_fit1,
                                n.groups = 3,
                                factor.names = c("Participation"),
                                item.prefixes = c("PRT"),
                                n.item = 11,
                                n.threshold = 5)
```

*Rejected: threshold model*

```{r}
prob_T3ml_fit2 = groupProbability(fit = T3.ml_fit2,
                                n.groups = 3,
                                factor.names = c("Participation"),
                                item.prefixes = c("PRT"),
                                n.item = 11,
                                n.threshold = 5)
```

### 3.3. Loadings

Create the model

```{r, message=FALSE}
T3.ml_mod3 = as.character(measEq.syntax(T3.ml_mod,
                                data = T3.ml_parto,         
                                ordered = T,           
                                parameterization = "delta",   
                                ID.fac = "std.lv",            
                                ID.cat = "Wu.Estabrook.2016", 
                                group = "Race",
                                group.equal = c("thresholds", "loadings"))) 
```

Fit the model

```{r, message=FALSE}
T3.ml_fit3 = cfa(T3.ml_mod3,
              data = T3.ml_parto,
              ordered = T,
              group = "Race")
```

Check fit measures

```{r}
fitMeasures(T3.ml_fit3, fit.measures = names_fit)
```

**Comparison**

```{r}
fit_diff(T3.ml_fit2, T3.ml_fit3)
```

### Full comparison

Fit indices

```{r}
T3.ml_MI <- rbind(
  configural = fitmeasures(T3.ml_fit1, fit.measures = names_fit),
  threshold  = fitmeasures(T3.ml_fit2, fit.measures = names_fit),
  loading    = fitmeasures(T3.ml_fit3, fit.measures = names_fit))

T3.ml_MI <- T3.ml_MI %>%
  cbind(., chisq_df = .[, "chisq.scaled"] / .[, "df.scaled"]) %>%
  .[, c("chisq.scaled", "df.scaled", "chisq_df", "cfi.scaled", "rmsea.scaled",
        "rmsea.ci.lower.scaled", "rmsea.ci.upper.scaled", "srmr")]

T3.ml_MI = round(T3.ml_MI, 3)
colnames(T3.ml_MI) = names_short
```

Differences in fit indices

```{r}
T3.ml_diff <- rbind(
  conf_thres = fit_diff(T3.ml_fit1, T3.ml_fit2),
  thres_load = fit_diff(T3.ml_fit2, T3.ml_fit3))
```

**All results**

```{r}
T3.ml_results = list(MI = T3.ml_MI,
                     diff = T3.ml_diff)
T3.ml_results
```


### Remove objects

```{r, eval=TRUE}
rm(T3.ml_parto, T3.ml_mod)
rm(T3.ml_mod1, T3.ml_mod2, T3.ml_mod3)
rm(T3.ml_fit1, T3.ml_fit2, T3.ml_fit3)
rm(prob_T3ml_fit1, prob_T3ml_fit2)
rm(T3.ml_MI, T3.ml_diff)
```
